ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate the central 65% of the visible fluke area, contrasted against low-intensity black pixels localized on the perimeter and linear striations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zones occupy the medial and distal regions of both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous band along the leading and trailing edges, with high-contrast linear streaks radiating from the peduncle and trailing margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 70 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; distinct macro-level pixel void (notch) located on the distal third of the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave curvature toward the distal tips, while leading edges show a smooth convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of roughly 4-6 high-contrast, raised circular nodules (barnacles) visible on the extreme lateral margin of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral fields of both lobes, primarily oriented vertically and diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch/missing tissue on the trailing edge of the left lobe; visible barnacle colonization on the left fluke tip margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense concentration of vertical dark striations and mottling concentrated near the base of the median notch.
